title: Inverse moments are cheap only because the independent conditional sectors are supplied
statement: With M=EB,V_B=Var B,p0=eta^2 and zeta=exp[-M^2/(2sum Delta_i^2)], the reported rational bounds give (1-p0)^2/M<=alpha<=1/M+2V_B/M^3+zeta/delta and tau<=4/M^2+zeta/delta^2. Fixed positive bounded couplings yield absolute energy width O(n^-2) and cat infidelity O(n^-2). For rational u_i=2+i/(2n),J_i=(u_i^2-1)/(2u_i), the1025-spin result is lambda in[355.59980262309690,355.59981149157808], squared fidelity>=.999992768010983131, and physical E0 in[-1380.59981149157808,-1380.59980262309690]. These are separate reported exact rational inequalities, not sampled confidence intervals or replayed predecessor data. The chosen local guide has gap<=2eta (below6.74e-133 in that case), but global sampling is a fair central draw plus independent bath draws, O(n). The ideal cat costs1H+n rotations+n controlled gates with O(n) shared-control depth; rotation angle O(n^-3/2) gives O(n^-1) trace error when other gates are ideal. General operation errors, bit growth, parameter acquisition and analytic sector discovery are paid. No new energy tractability or matched runtime advantage over Bravyi–Gosset/conditional-product/tensor/Schur methods follows.
